summary: Diff implements Hero button label change to “Media”, adds/changes hero background rendering from MediaStore, enhances MusicPlayer autoplay/tap-to-start behavior, and begins adding draft preview URL management in MediaManager; MediaStoreContext changes suggest new local/backend loading logic but are truncated, so full preview/live fallback and clear/publish behaviors can’t be fully verified.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure uploaded/published media is visible in both preview and live/production modes with correct fallback to backend-published media when local IndexedDB media is absent (Hero, all image/video slots, and song).
missing_requirements.reason: MediaStoreContext changes related to loading local vs published media are truncated; the diff summary does not provide complete evidence that backend-published media is fetched on fresh load with empty storage, that live/production renders without refresh, and that cleared published slots reliably fall back to placeholders (no broken blanks).
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (only describes behavior; not full code evidence)

missing_requirements.requirement: Add an explicit, user-friendly pre-publish preview inside Media Manager labeled in English (e.g., “Preview”) showing draft Hero, draft images (ordered, transforms applied), draft videos, and draft song audio preview; it must update immediately on staged changes and show placeholders for staged clears.
missing_requirements.reason: MediaManager shows added state for draft preview URLs, but the diff is truncated before any UI section labeled “Preview” (and before evidence of image/video grids with order/transforms and an audio preview element wired to draft song). Immediate placeholder behavior for staged clears is also not verifiable from the truncated excerpt.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure clear actions are understandable and reliably remove media references so UI falls back to placeholders in preview and live views after Submit and persists after reload.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff excerpt does not show the clear-action UI/handlers end-to-end (draft clear -> preview placeholder immediately; submit -> live UI updates immediately without refresh; reload persists cleared state). This may exist in truncated portions, but it is not provable from the provided diff summary.

hallucinated_features.description: Changed/added extensive non-requested HeroSection user-facing copy (including many emojis and non-English/vernacular terms) and decorative bouncing emoji elements.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest focuses on media preview/live rendering, audio playback reliability, and renaming the Hero media button label. Large changes to displayed hero text/content are not requested and also appear to conflict with the constraint that all user-facing text must be in English.

hallucinated_features.description: Tap-to-start prompt includes an emoji (“Tap to start music 🎵”).
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-44 requests an English call-to-action; adding an emoji is not requested and may conflict with strict “all user-facing text must be in English” constraint depending on interpretation.
